personal.tagline: Senior AI Engineer & Full Stack Developer
personal.bio: I build multi-tenant SaaS platforms, AI applications and MVPs for startups and growing companies — taking products from idea to production with architecture that stays easy to maintain, scale and improve.
personal.closingBio: Ready to collaborate on something extraordinary? I'm always excited to connect with fellow innovators, explore cutting-edge projects, and push the boundaries of what's possible with technology. Let's build the future together.
story: Building a SaaS product or AI application is more than writing code. The early architecture decisions can determine how difficult the product becomes to maintain, scale and improve later.
I'm a Senior AI Engineer and Full Stack Developer with 10+ years of experience building SaaS platforms, business applications, automation systems and MVPs for startups and growing companies.

I work across the stack, with strong experience in Python, Node.js, PHP, React, PostgreSQL, APIs, Azure, cloud architecture and third-party integrations. I can take ownership of the technical side of a product from database and API design through frontend development, AI integration, deployment and ongoing improvements.

A major part of my work is building multi-tenant SaaS applications. I design systems around proper tenant isolation, user roles and permissions, scalable data models, authentication, integrations, background processing and the infrastructure needed to support multiple customers without turning the codebase into a maintenance problem.

I also build practical AI functionality using LLMs, RAG, AI agents, document processing, intelligent search and workflow automation. My approach is simple: AI should solve a specific product or business problem and fit naturally into the existing workflow.

I enjoy working directly with founders, CTOs and product teams, especially when the requirements are still evolving. I can help define the technical approach, make architecture decisions and then actually build the system rather than stopping at documentation or high-level recommendations.
Whether you're starting an MVP, launching a multi-tenant SaaS product, or adding AI to an existing application, I can help take it from idea to production.
